name: Neutrl USD
oneLiner: NUSD is Neutrl's synthetic dollar backed by liquid stablecoins and delta-hedged OTC positions; 1:1 mint/redeem via USDC, USDT, or USDe.
collateral: Accountable currently shows reserves concentrated in liquid stablecoins, with smaller OTC aggregate and other hedged reserve assets; Neutrl describes NUSD as a fully collateralized synthetic dollar backed by delta-neutral strategies and other crypto assets
pegMechanism: 1:1 mint and redeem via permissionless router using USDC, USDT, or USDe; peg maintained by arbitrage incentives, delta hedging of derivatives positions, and rapid reserve deployment from liquid stablecoin buffer

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: reviewed metadata indicates a direct issuer, admin, proxy, pause, burn, or upgrade control surface beyond reserve-only exposure.

mintAuthority.summary: NUSD is a synthetic delta-neutral dollar whose token grants MINTER_ROLE to Neutrl's StableMinter and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to a separate admin; mint is routed through Neutrl's Router.sol into AssetReserve/StableMinter, while redemption is KYC-gated.

controls.label: NUSD StableMinter MINTER_ROLE
controls.capDescription: NUSD is minted only by holders of MINTER_ROLE; in practice the Router.sol mint() flow pulls collateral into AssetReserve.sol and a Minter contract issues NUSD 1:1, with a maxMintPerBlock rate limit.

routeChecks.rateLimits: Mint enforces maxMintPerBlock to limit per-block issuance.
routeChecks.signingModel: Mint is permissionless via Router.sol; redemption is restricted to KYC/KYB-approved counterparties (asymmetric design).

controls.evidence: Ethereum role reads on 2026-05-25 confirmed 0xFF0B98C0B1d8390b2A7cFFBCcd4e20bFcfb8191D holds MINTER_ROLE; Neutrl docs list it as StableMinter and describe Router.sol mint() routing collateral to AssetReserve.sol before StableMinter issues NUSD with a maxMintPerBlock cap.

controls.label: NUSD DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (token admin)
controls.capDescription: The NUSD token admin (DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, with transferAdmin/acceptAdmin) can grant/revoke MINTER_ROLE and DENYLIST_MANAGER_ROLE, concentrating mint-authorization and denylist control in a single admin.
controls.evidence: Ethereum hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) reads on 2026-05-25 returned true for 0x51De41ec06e779715d7FB71Ef83A736cFc903217 and false for the prior constructor/admin address 0xE78615F841c3C013173FBE7679d17442C8673Cc1.

review.evidence: Ethereum reads of the NUSD token show MINTER_ROLE assigned to StableMinter 0xFF0B98C0B1d8390b2A7cFFBCcd4e20bFcfb8191D, live DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE at 0x51De41ec06e779715d7FB71Ef83A736cFc903217, and denylist roles; Neutrl docs describe permissionless Router.sol minting 1:1 against liquid stablecoins with a per-block cap and KYC-gated redemption.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Token-level MINTER_ROLE/admin and Router mint flow confirmed from Ethereum role reads and Neutrl docs; whether the live admin is an EOA, multisig, or Safe was not verified on-chain.
unresolvedQuestions: Confirm whether the NUSD admin address 0x51De41ec06e779715d7FB71Ef83A736cFc903217 is an EOA, multisig, or Safe before raising confidence.
Phase 0c (2026-06-11): at least one mint-capable authority remains unresolved or non-addressable in current chain state; keep manual-review until that role is identified and checked.
